# Streamfog MCP — Full Documentation

AI-driven AR lens orchestrator for live OBS streams. Controls Streamfog face
filters, AR effects, and Vtuber avatars through MCP tools via the local
Streamer.bot WebSocket bridge.

## Quick Facts

- Ports: backend 10994 (FastAPI + FastMCP streamable HTTP at /mcp), frontend 10995 (Vite)
- Repo: https://github.com/sandraschi/streamfog-mcp
- Start: `uv sync` then `start.ps1` (or `uv run -m streamfog_mcp --stdio` for MCP-only)
- Python: >=3.12, FastMCP >=3.4.4

## Architecture

```
LLM Agent -> streamfog-mcp (:10994) -> Streamer.bot WebSocket (:8080) -> Streamfog Desktop -> OBS
                         \-> FastAPI REST (/api/*) -> React Dashboard (:10995)
MCP endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:10994/mcp (streamable HTTP) or stdio
```

## MCP Tools (5)

| Tool | Description | Params |
|------|-------------|--------|
| `streamfog_status` | Bridge connection health + lens count | none |
| `streamfog_set_lens` | Activate a specific AR lens or face filter | `lens_identifier` (required) |
| `streamfog_clear_effects` | Strip all effects, return camera to baseline | none |
| `streamfog_toggle_avatar` | Toggle Vtuber-style avatar on/off | none |
| `streamfog_list_lenses` | List configured lenses from lenses.json | `reload` (bool, default false) |

All tools return `{success, message, data}`. Actions are fire-and-forget:
Streamer.bot does not report outcomes.

## REST API

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `/api/health` | GET | Liveness probe (status, version, uptime, tool_count, providers) |
| `/api/v1/status` | GET | Server + bridge health |
| `/api/v1/lenses` | GET | List lenses |
| `/api/v1/lenses/set` | POST | Activate lens `{"lens_identifier": "..."}` |
| `/api/v1/lenses/reload` | POST | Reload lens map |
| `/api/v1/effects/clear` | POST | Clear all effects |
| `/api/v1/avatar/toggle` | POST | Toggle avatar |
| `/api/tools` | GET | Dynamic tool list with schemas |
| `/api/capabilities` | GET | Capability discovery |
| `/api/skills` | GET | Skill list |
| `/api/skills/{name}` | GET | Skill content (markdown) |
| `/api/llm/discover` | GET | Ollama/LM Studio/vLLM probe + GPU detection |
| `/api/logs` | GET | Ring-buffer log window (source/level/search/limit) |
| `/api/v1/diagnostics` | GET | Tool list, system info, errors (CUA-NSIS) |

## Configuration

All env vars use prefix `STREAMFOG_MCP_` (also read from `.env` at repo root):

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `STREAMFOG_MCP_STREAMERBOT_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Streamer.bot WebSocket host |
| `STREAMFOG_MCP_STREAMERBOT_PORT` | `8080` | Streamer.bot WebSocket port |
| `STREAMFOG_MCP_STREAMERBOT_TOKEN` | - | Streamer.bot auth token |
| `STREAMFOG_MCP_LENS_MAP_PATH` | `lenses.json` | Lens-to-action mapping file |
| `STREAMFOG_MCP_PORT` | `10994` | Backend port |
| `STREAMFOG_MCP_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Backend bind host |
| `STREAMFOG_MCP_LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` | Logging level |

## Lens Map (lenses.json)

```json
{
  "beauty_smooth": "SetLens_BeautySmooth",
  "cyber_helmet": "SetLens_CyberHelmet",
  "vtuber": "SetLens_VTuberAvatar"
}
```

Keys beginning with `_` are ignored. Unknown identifiers fall back to the
constructed action name `SetLens_{identifier}`.

## Dual Transport

`run_server.py` (PyInstaller entry) reads `MCP_PORT`/`MCP_HOST` env vars:
when set, starts in dual mode (REST + MCP at /mcp) on that port; otherwise
runs stdio mode. The Tauri wrapper sets these vars when spawning.

## MCP Client Registration

- Claude Desktop / Cursor / opencode: stdio entry running `streamfog-mcp`
  (or `uv run -m streamfog_mcp --stdio`)
- HTTP: `http://127.0.0.1:10994/mcp` with streamable HTTP protocol

## Testing

```powershell
uv run pytest tests/ -v
cd webapp && npx playwright test   # e2e (backend auto-started)
```

## Troubleshooting

- "Not connected to Streamer.bot": enable Streamer.bot WebSocket server, check port 8080
- "Dispatch failed" auth error: match STREAMFOG_MCP_STREAMERBOT_TOKEN to Streamer.bot token
- Action sent but nothing happens: action name mismatch in lenses.json vs Streamer.bot Actions
- Zero lenses: lenses.json missing/invalid at STREAMFOG_MCP_LENS_MAP_PATH

See [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) for the full guide.
